reason: I won't set up a wallet or hold USDC for a business purchase, so this is dead on arrival. And winner-takes-all feels like spec work to me, where most people who put in effort get nothing.
objection: It's crypto-only (USDC on Solana) and I avoid that entirely. On top of that it's unaudited, invite-only and from a tiny team, and I'd be paying 55 for something I can get from a freelancer for a fixed fee without the spec-work ethics problem.
would_change_my_mind: Pay by card or invoice in dollars with no wallet on my side, plus a track record or an audit and fair pay for entrants, not only the winners.
